model.detection: No possible corrupted character impersonates a different clean character
model.correction: Possible observation sets of different characters are disjoint
model.capacity: Maximum number of arbitrary binary glyphs; not a human legibility claim
model.cover_known: Cover identity is supplied to the decoder
model.cover_unknown: Cover identity absent; hidden positions appear dark

charset_note: Scientific notation is a multi-position grammar. Decimal point is often an independent light/attribute; 13 tokens is only an inventory comparison, not a display design.
